author: Axiom III
title: Challenging the Backbone: Transformer Encoder with RNN Aggregator
abstract: After multiple failed attempts to improve the SOTA by modifying its RNN aggregator, this experiment pivots to challenge the foundational DSConv backbone. This submission tests the hypothesis that a different feature extractor can unlock a higher performance ceiling. The DSConv block is replaced with a Transformer Encoder, while retaining the simple and effective uni-directional GRU aggregator (with projection layer) from the SOTA's effective architecture. The goal is to break out of the current local optimum by exploring a fundamentally different approach to feature extraction based on self-attention.
